verdicts.explanation: Section 3.3.2 states that the nondefective m-LBO supercell has σ = 7.0 × 10−13 S cm−1 at 300 K, computed by the authors from the DFT barrier via Eq. (5). Origin, temperature, and the null secondary fields all check out.

The text gives σ = 2.8 × 10−2 S cm−1 at 300 K for the boron-vacancy m-LBO supercell, derived from the 0.27 eV forward barrier in this paper. Origin is computational and the secondary fields are correctly null.

The text gives σ = 8.3 × 10−3 S cm−1 at 300 K for the oxygen-vacancy m-LBO supercell, computed from the 0.63 eV forward barrier in this paper. Material, unit, temperature, origin and nulls are all correct.
